alpha_ops_nasdaq_snapshot_help: Rebuilds the NASDAQ closing screener (price and volume) that determines eligibility for the next scan.
alpha_ops_global_sync_help: Fetches tickers, Yahoo symbols, countries, and exchanges from HuggingFace (about 63,000 rows). Defines the global universe without capturing fundamentals.
alpha_ops_nasdaq_fundamentals_help: Captures fundamentals for the full eligible universe, so changing the liquidity floor does not require another capture.
alpha_ops_global_fundamentals_help: Captures the synchronized global universe. Filter by country and exchange before making real requests; this takes hours.
alpha_ops_observatory_help: Runs the monthly pipeline with real models and costs, without proposing or changing portfolios. Refreshes ranking, watchlist, memory, and trace.
alpha_ops_reanalyze_help: Reassesses only previously analyzed companies using current macro data, without scanning the universe again.
alpha_ops_rebuild_portfolio_help: Rebuilds the portfolio from existing reports using current score and position limits. Reassigns weights without rescoring.
alpha_ops_rebuild_warning: Writes a new proposal that replaces the current one.
alpha_ops_decision_scan_help: Scores the universe, builds the monthly portfolio, and submits it for your approval.
alpha_ops_decision_warning: The only action here that writes a proposal and executes the shadow ledger.
alpha_ops_fx_help: Fetches USD exchange rates and recalculates recent snapshots’ market caps in dollars. Runs automatically at 5:00.
alpha_ops_analytics_help: Rebuilds the DuckDB file used for stage costs, prescore confidence, and universe exploration. Runs daily.
alpha_ops_prune_help: Removes text from AI calls older than three months from Postgres only when archived in DuckDB. Keeps tokens, costs, and latency.
alpha_ops_prune_warning: Removes text from Postgres. The text remains in the DuckDB archive.
alpha_ops_fx_done: {currencies} currencies synced · {count} snapshots recalculated in USD.
